title: Three Lānaʻi Planning Commission seats opening
summary: At the August 19, 2026 meeting, the chair asked that three commission seats opening March 31, 2027 be listed in the director's report. Applications for those vacancies are due December 31, 2026. In May, the chair had said the nominations board must receive applications by that date for terms ending in March 2027.
